title: Omega Mag-Bind® Total RNA Isolation
author: Opentrons
materials: Download your protocol and unzip if needed.

steps.title: Load samples onto magnetic module
steps.instruction: Place the samples in a NEST deepwell plate on the magnetic module; arrange reagents in the two 12‑channel reservoirs as shown in the Setup diagram; be prepared to move the deepwell isolation plate to and from the magnetic module and the QInstruments Bioshake during the run.

steps.title: Enter protocol parameters
steps.instruction: Input all required protocol parameters in the OT App interface as prompted.

steps.title: Download and unzip protocol file
steps.instruction: Download the protocol file from the provided source and unzip it if necessary.

steps.title: Upload custom labware to OT App
steps.instruction: In the OT App, go to More → Custom Labware → Add Labware and select the appropriate .json labware files, if needed.

steps.title: Upload protocol script to OT App
steps.instruction: Navigate to the Protocol tab in the OT App and upload the .py protocol file.

steps.title: Set up deck according to map
steps.instruction: Arrange the deck hardware (magnetic module, tip racks, reservoirs, etc.) exactly as shown in the provided deck map.

steps.title: Calibrate labware, tiprack, and pipette
steps.instruction: Run the calibration routine in the OT App to calibrate the labware, tip rack, and pipette; consult the support articles for calibration tips if needed.

steps.title: Start the run
steps.instruction: Press ‘Run’ in the OT App to begin the automated RNA isolation protocol.
